country.name: India
country.kicker: A world of differences, within one country.

overview.summary: The world’s most populous country is a multilingual federal democracy with extraordinary regional variety. A vast domestic market and global services industry coexist with very uneven opportunities and infrastructure.
overview.geography: The Himalayas mark the northern edge; a broad peninsula reaches into the Indian Ocean. The Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal flank it, while the monsoon shapes water and agriculture.

whyItMatters.title: Scale that shapes the future
whyItMatters.text: Jobs, cities, energy, and education in India will matter far beyond its borders because of the sheer number of people involved.

whyItMatters.title: Services that connect the world
whyItMatters.text: Software, business services, and a global diaspora link Indian skills and enterprises to organizations across continents.

stories.question: How can one country contain so many languages?
stories.summary: India’s diversity is built into its everyday life and political structure.

sections.title: Regions with deep histories
sections.text: Language communities developed across different regions over centuries. The Constitution recognizes 22 scheduled languages, but many more languages are spoken.

sections.title: Governing through plurality
sections.text: States have important roles in language policy. Hindi and English are used at the Union level; there is no single constitutionally designated national language.

stories.takeaway: India becomes easier to understand when you start with its regions, not a single national stereotype.

scene.mapNote: Mountains, river plains, and peninsular regions hold different linguistic histories.

stories.question: Why is the monsoon more than weather?
stories.summary: A seasonal shift in winds helps organize the rhythm of a country.

sections.title: Rain arrives unevenly
sections.text: Summer monsoon rains provide much of India’s annual water. Timing, location, and intensity matter as much as the total amount.

sections.title: A chain of consequences
sections.text: Rainfall affects reservoirs, crops, food prices, hydropower, and flood risk. Irrigation and urban infrastructure can reduce some vulnerabilities, but cannot remove them all.

stories.takeaway: Weather becomes a national story when so many livelihoods depend on the same seasonal system.

scene.mapNote: Moisture arrives from the surrounding seas and interacts with the land.

stories.question: How did India become a global technology hub?
stories.summary: The familiar software story rests on skills, connections, and concentrated opportunity.

sections.title: Build an exportable service
sections.text: Technical education, English-language skills, communications networks, and international demand helped Indian software and business services expand.

sections.title: Growth is geographically uneven
sections.text: Technology activity clusters in certain urban regions. A successful export industry creates opportunities, but does not represent the experience of every worker in a country this large.

stories.takeaway: India’s technology sector is globally important and still only one part of a much more varied economy.

scene.mapNote: International connections link a few major technology regions to distant customers.
